0022600165.text: The Grizzlies (5-0, first in the Southwest and first in the West) are hosting the 2-4 Pelicans (11th in the West, fifth in the Southwest and 3.5 games back), with Memphis at 1-0 at home and 4-0 on the road and riding a five-game winning streak. Memphis is missing Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness, averaging 25.8 points per game), while New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal reasons), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and their last meeting came on January 30, 2026, in New Orleans, where Memphis lost 114-106.
